open_issues.impact: A real browser client of @vaulter/vue-collaboration would never save: the hub would drop its writes. Found by the protocol 2 e2e conversion; invisible to unit tests.
open_issues.next: Fix in vue-collaboration (pass parameters {protocol: 2} / append ?protocol=2) or in HocuspocusCollaborationDriver url, with a test, before the e2e is run in PLAN4.
open_issues.text: Clients end up read-only on the hub: nothing adds protocol=2 to the hub URL. hub/src/index.js readClientProtocol treats a connection without protocol=2 as protocol 1 (read-only). packages/vue-collaboration/src/transport.ts builds HocuspocusProvider without parameters, and neither the PHP driver nor the session url adds it. The stand/e2e clients add it themselves (test/support/live.js hubUrl).

open_issues.text: Stand and e2e files are syntax-checked only (node --check, bash -n, YAML parse); yjs, @hocuspocus/provider and docker are unavailable in the sandbox and D41 forbids running them. Unverified assumptions: Hocuspocus provider 4.3 keeps a query string given in url and delivers stateless messages as {payload}; 'docker compose ps -a --format json' rows carry Service/State/ExitCode; the hub drain leaves the management listener answering between the first 503 and process exit (shutdown.js closes it last); a hub killed with SIGTERM exits 0 when its ledger is empty.

open_issues.text: scripts/collab-stand.sh runs node --test with --test-concurrency=1 (the guidance names plain node --test): the scenarios SIGKILL/SIGTERM the same containers and must not run in parallel. The stand backend uses 'testbench migrate' (not migrate:fresh) so the scenarios can restart it without losing data. Scenario 10's observable drain window is narrow when nothing is pending; readiness is polled every 25 ms and the test fails if no 503 is seen.

For P5.14 (CI/release manifest): the hub suite's list_glob deliberately does not include test/stand (hub baseline unchanged), the stand lane must stay out of any PLAN3 job, and the compose builds the hub image from packages/collaboration/hub (context '..').
